building: John C. Smalley Center for Housing & Food Service Administration

sources.provider: Purdue University official campus building footprint service
sources.source_name: John C. Smalley Center For Housing & Food Service Administration
sources.measurement_method: All 16 distinct source-ring vertices transformed with the project-local conversion; compared to the reopened mesh base vertices.
sources.observation: The official polygon describes the currently mapped building footprint, not a certified survey. Its transformed area is 2114.46 m2; the GIS feature also reports NUM_LEVELS=2 and Extrution=12, with no documented units or field definitions.
sources.uncertainty: The service publishes no positional or dimensional accuracy, vertical datum, or definition of its extrusion attribute.

sources.provider: Purdue University Archives and Special Collections
sources.source_date: Historical record; page does not date the web publication
sources.measurement_method: Archival building-history description; no dimensions measured.
sources.observation: The administration building for the women's residence halls was constructed north of Meredith Hall in 1963, expanded in 1982, and renamed John C. Smalley Center in 1985. The archive lists earlier forms including Residence Halls Administration Building and Women's Residence Hall Annex.
sources.uncertainty: No plan, elevation, addition boundary, or facade specification is provided. The current GIS footprint is used as a single building outline; the 1982 addition is not separated.

sources.provider: Purdue University Residences official contact page
sources.measurement_method: Current building-directory/address information; no geometry measured.
sources.observation: Identifies Smalley Center as the University Residences housing and food-services administration location and gives the address 1225 Third Street, West Lafayette, IN 47907-2008.
sources.uncertainty: Address confirms identity, not a particular entrance or facade bearing.

modeling_decisions.footprint: Use mapped GIS ring as the building plan shell; preserve all 16 distinct ring vertices.
modeling_decisions.floors: Model two levels, consistent with the GIS NUM_LEVELS=2 attribute; level-height distribution is not independently established.
modeling_decisions.height: 7.6 m estimate only; no elevation drawing or measured height was found.
modeling_decisions.facade: Neutral institutional materials, repeated windows, plinth, floor bands and coping are schematic; no georeferenced facade photograph or elevation drawing currently supports exact finish, window pattern, roof form or door position.
modeling_decisions.historic_addition: The 1982 expansion is documented, but its footprint is not available and is not guessed or separately delineated.
